evidence.name: Screen field: Style the bullet titles
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Style the bullet titles" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Style the bullet titles
sections.description: Styles the main line of every feature bullet: font, size, weight, color, alignment, and spacing, applied to all bullets at once. Keep bullet titles bold and easy to read so each benefit lands at a glance. The theme defaults usually work, so change them only if a benefit is hard to read.
